comment: 52yo Eastern-European male, traditional Slavic diet with heavy daily intake of pickled vegetables (sauerkraut, salt-cured cucumbers, herring) + estimated salt intake >8 g/day. H. pylori positive on serology (untreated, asymptomatic). No personal gastric cancer, no family history. Salt-preserved foods are a probable cause of gastric cancer per IARC + WCRF (RR ~1.5-2.0 high vs low quartile), synergistic with H. pylori. Fires RF-LIFESTYLE-SALTY-PICKLED-DIET-GASTRIC-PREVENTION (relevant_diseases: gastric). Engine routes to PreventionPlan: default = IND-LIFESTYLE-SALTY-PICKLED-DIET-GASTRIC-PREVENTION-SURVEILLANCE (reduce salt to WHO <5 g/day + H. pylori eradication + Mediterranean/DASH dietary pattern shift); alternative = IND-LIFESTYLE-SALTY-PICKLED-DIET-GASTRIC-PREVENTION-OBSERVATION (background screening adherence only).
